LESSON: LISTENING AND SPEAKING 8.1.1ATTENTIVE LISTENING

Grade: Grade 4
Subject: INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES
Strand: Strand 8
Topic 8.1: Listening and Speaking 8.1.1Attentive Listening
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Listening and Speaking 8.1.1Attentive Listening, part of Strand 8 in Grade 4 INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES.

Key inquiry question: How do we respond during a telephone conversation? 2. How do we ask questions during conversations?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

A. describe digital devices for information,

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Listening and Speaking 8.1.1Attentive Listening in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

B. use polite expressions in an oral conversation,

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Listening and Speaking 8.1.1Attentive Listening in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

C. enjoy using appropriate and polite expressions during conversations.

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Listening and Speaking 8.1.1Attentive Listening in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. describe digital devices for information,

   Listening and Speaking 8.1.1Attentive Listening helps learners achieve this outcome through discussion, practice, and activities at school. Think about how this applies in daily life in Kenya — at home, on the farm, in town, or at school.

B. use polite expressions in an oral conversation,

   Listening and Speaking 8.1.1Attentive Listening helps learners achieve this outcome through discussion, practice, and activities at school. Think about how this applies in daily life in Kenya — at home, on the farm, in town, or at school.

C. enjoy using appropriate and polite expressions during conversations.

   Listening and Speaking 8.1.1Attentive Listening helps learners achieve this outcome through discussion, practice, and activities at school. Think about how this applies in daily life in Kenya — at home, on the farm, in town, or at school.

D. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. jointly work with peers to describe digital devices based on aspects like colour, height, size, shape,

2. work collaboratively to match digital devices to their uses,

3. role play a telephone conversation from a call centre with peers articulately,

4. collaborate to list the polite expressions used in the telephone conversation,

5. answer questions based on the telephone conversation. 1.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. jointly work with peers to describe digital devices based on aspects like colour, height, size, shape,
2. work collaboratively to match digital devices to their uses,
3. role play a telephone conversation from a call centre with peers articulately,
4. collaborate to list the polite expressions used in the telephone conversation,
5. answer questions based on the telephone conversation. 1.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Listening and Speaking 8.1.1Attentive Listening together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Self-efficacy: This is enhanced as the learner shows concerted attention when answering questions based on a telephone

conversation.

44

• Communication and Collaboration: This is exhibited as the learner speaks engagingly when holding a telephone conversation

using polite expressions.

Values:
• Respect: This is enhanced as the learner appreciates diverse opinions when working with peers to match digital devices to

their uses.

• Unity: This is promoted as the learner cooperates with peers to describe digital devices.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

ICT: This is promoted as the learner uses the digital devices in the role-play telephone conversations appropriately.

Link to other Learning Areas:

The learner can relate the concept of telephone conversations and communication to their learning in Science and Technology.

3. enjoy using appropriate and polite expressions during conversations.
